item.title: How I Built an Animated GitHub Profile README (ASCII Portrait + Neofetch Card + Live Contribution Graph)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to building a terminal-style GitHub profile README — a self-typing monochrome ASCII portrait, a neofetch-style info card, and a live contribution heatmap, all animated SVG auto-refreshed daily by GitHub Actions.

item.title: The Prompts I Used to Build a Drivable 3D Car Game (React Three Fiber + Rapier)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A Bruno-Simon-style drivable 3D car game built with React Three Fiber and Rapier physics — the full one-shot prompt, an 8-step incremental build, and a refinement round for vehicle feel and the water shader.

item.title: How I Rendered a Rotating 3D ASCII Wordmark That Animates on GitHub (No JavaScript)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: Extrude a word into a 3D slab, rasterize it to ASCII, and ship twenty rotated frames as one 38 KB SVG that animates on GitHub with SMIL and no JavaScript — plus the three geometry bugs that looked like rendering faults.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build a Frosted-Glass Refraction Cube in Raw WebGL (One HTML File)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable prompt for a frosted-glass cube floating in front of giant type, where the letters genuinely refract and smear through the glass — two-bounce raymarched refraction, chromatic aberration and film grain in one index.html with no build step, no npm and no Three.js.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build a Fluid Ink-Reveal Homepage, with a Higgsfield-Generated Wordmark Video
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable prompt for a homepage where dragging the cursor spreads ink that punches through the page to a looping video of the same word morphing through 3D materials — a WebGL Navier-Stokes fluid as the mask, and the video generated with the Higgsfield MCP.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build Pin Board, a Single-File Sticky-Notes App (No Backend, No Build Step)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable prompt for a draggable, resizable sticky-notes board with per-note colour, font and checklist modes — one HTML file, vanilla JS, everything persisted to localStorage. Plus why each clause is in the prompt.

item.title: 25 Projects To Build To Get Hired in 2026
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: 25 portfolio projects reverse-engineered from what YC and Accel are funding in 2026 — MCP servers, eval harnesses, agent infrastructure, and physical-world data. Ranked beginner to hard, with the hiring signal each one sends.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build a Hover-Reveal Spaceship Scanner, with Higgsfield-Generated Hull Layers
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable prompt for a landing page where the cursor is an X-ray torch — sweep it over a dead, powered-down starship and only that part of the hull lights up with plasma conduits and blazing engine bells. Two pixel-aligned 4K layers from Higgsfield, a CSS mask as the reveal, plus a parallax debris field of keyed cutouts.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build a Kinetic Wind Wall in Three.js (2,000 Metal Blades, All Moved in the Vertex Shader)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable prompt for a curved wall of ~2,000 metal louvres that ripples with a procedural wind field and parts around the cursor — all motion in an onBeforeCompile patch on MeshPhysicalMaterial, reflections from a runtime PMREM studio, zero texture or HDR files. Plus the three silent bugs that cost me an evening.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build a Punch-Through Ice Wall in Three.js (Voronoi Shatter + Refracted Hero Reveal)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable prompt for a landing page sealed behind frosted mint ice — punch it five times and the wall fractures into ~90 real Voronoi shards that tumble past the camera, refracting the hero text as they fly. Two-pass render-target refraction, hand-rolled fracture, no physics engine.

item.title: The Prompt I Used to Build Hook Lab in Emergent (20 Scored Instagram Hooks, Biased Toward What Already Worked)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: A copy-pasteable Emergent prompt for a full-stack hook-writing app — one line in, 20 tagged and scored hooks out, with a two-second red flag computed in code, a caption generator with per-section regeneration, and a loop that learns which hook formats actually perform on your own account.

item.title: Turning Yourself Into Spider-Man in React (MediaPipe Pose → a Mixamo Rig in React Three Fiber)
item.author: avivashishta29@gmail.com (Avi Vashishta)
item.description: Capture a plate of your empty room, walk back in, and Spider-Man is standing exactly where you are — your height, your pose, your fingers. Retargeting MediaPipe pose and hand landmarks onto a Mixamo rig in React Three Fiber: the aim-at solver, a least-squares size fit, frame-independent finger solving, and the five bugs that each looked like something else.
